title: Prune the Leaky Neurons: Mitigating Private Data Leakage in Fine-Tuned LLMs via Joint-Embedding-Guided Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22792v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on proprietary records enables domain adaptation but introduces two challenges: (i) privacy leakage of memorized private data, such as personally identifiable information (PII), and (ii) balancing private data removal with utility preservation. Existing defenses, including data sanitization and differential privacy, often degrade performance, while privacy-neuron editing lacks a PII-free reference to distinguish identity-specific neurons from those supporting useful text. We propose JEPA-Prune, a post-hoc neuron pruning framework guided by a model trained exclusively on PII-free views. Alongside the fine-tuned private model, JEPA-Prune, trains a public model on surrogate and masked views of the same records using a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), capturing domain knowledge without identifiers. A cross-model representation probe quantifies deviations between private representation

translated_title: 剪除泄漏神经元：通过联合嵌入引导的剪枝缓解微调大语言模型中的隐私数据泄露
translated_abstract: 在专有记录上微调大语言模型（LLM）可以实现领域适配，但会带来两个挑战：（i）已记忆的隐私数据（如个人身份信息 PII）存在隐私泄露风险，（ii）需要在移除隐私数据与保持模型性能之间取得平衡。现有防御方法，包括数据清洗和差分隐私，往往会降低模型性能，而隐私神经元编辑方法则缺乏一个无 PII 的参照来区分身份特定神经元与支持有用文本的神经元。我们提出 JEPA-Prune，这是一个由仅在无 PII 视图上训练的模型所引导的事后神经元剪枝框架。在微调后的私有模型之外，JEPA-Prune 使用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在同一记录的替代视图和掩码视图上训练一个公开模型，从而在不包含标识符的情况下捕获领域知识。跨模型表示探针用于量化私有表示与公开表示之间的偏差……
tldr: 提出 JEPA-Prune 框架，利用在无个人身份信息的替代视图上通过联合嵌入预测架构训练的公开模型来引导事后神经元剪枝，在保持模型性能的同时有效缓解微调大语言模型中的隐私数据泄露问题。
en_tdlr: JEPA-Prune is a post-hoc neuron pruning framework guided by a public model trained via a joint-embedding predictive architecture on PII-free surrogate views, mitigating private data leakage in fine-tuned LLMs while preserving model utility.
